CONFLUENCE · SOURCE CANDIDATE 10893 · 9 NOV 2026
Preserve what the source actually tells us.
PR10893 now brings signal criteria beside desktop identity and before paired comparisons on narrow cards. The same content and natural keyboard order survive the 768px transition. Its paired baseline evidence, cached-reader fence, honest actions and actual successful-render overwrite proof remain. All 24 R2 cards retain anatomy placeholders; source-bound fixtures supply populated values. R4 below remains a preserved earlier proposal. Locked-copy now names the existing eligible-plan requirement; an empty fallback describes its snapshot without inferring today or rarity.
01 · Existing source path
scripts/build_confluence_screener.py reads site/factordata/tech_confluence.json and renders the public page plus its protected payload. PR10705 supplies the existing source qualification and full artifact receipt. PR10893 @d752f398 preserves those rules and adds one PAYLOAD_SCHEMA constant, passed to both available/unavailable template contexts and protected JSON. Only this Confluence asset advances to tier_payload.v2. Invalid required input still yields unavailable, null counts and empty rows. No new loader or source owner. The comparison, responsive-layout and copy increments change no builder or protected JSON.
02 · One availability branch
Use the existing qualification branch. Required source clock, coverage, split date, legs, IDs, active ticker lists and numeric evidence must pass _source_receipt(). Invalid required input means unavailable, not zero. A qualified artifact with combos.long=[] means available with zero eligible combinations. Otherwise _eligible_long_combos() selects active rows with both historical rates, orders by rank_score and supplies at most three cards. Preserve the same receipt and selection rule in both public and protected projections; add no loader, availability service or second selection owner. The retained free-card empty-ticker template branch is latent under this selector; do not invent a new availability rule to reach it.
03 · Missingness & clocks
A qualified receipt requires timezone-aware generated_utc. Missing, date-only or invalid source time makes the source unavailable and its matching count unknown. source_built is the full source-generation time; it is not a market observation clock. The template explicitly says market observation time is not supplied. The separate page generated_utc must never substitute for missing source time. Required period fire/month counts qualify the source; absent optional history, baselines, edges or consistency remain unknown. Preserve legitimate supplied zero/false without inventing a negative historical conclusion. Render edge_test_pp and edge_train_pp independently. Never derive a missing difference from displayed rates or detailed baseline levels. Exact zero is neutral 0.0; signed values below 0.1 percentage points keep two significant digits so a nonzero result cannot appear as zero.
04 · Counts, order & scope
n_active_total counts all eligible active combinations before the top-three cap. combos|length counts displayed cards, from zero to three; universe_n is separate source coverage. Current candidate headings and Showing N of M copy distinguish those scopes. Keep rank_score order and stable ties, combo_id, is_free and active_count. Zero means this qualified source contains no active combinations with readings for both periods. It does not mean all market signals are inactive. Do not fabricate rows, dates, ranks, legs or samples.
05 · Card layout & controls
Move the existing legs list once into .lc-top after title/history and before comparisons. At 768px+, rank/title occupy the first row, criteria sit under the title, and the 310px evidence rail spans both rows; keep a 16px title-to-criteria gap. Below 768px, criteria and comparisons each span the card width. Keep the separate 640px hero/padding rules. Shrinkable grid/text columns wrap long tokens without truncation. Preserve independent supplied period deltas, aligned rates/samples, the visible percentage-point heading and display-rank heading IDs. Eight R2 anatomy references now omit active-looking filter bars. All eight bars and four mobile filter sheets retain their original IDs on p-4-0. Current source has no filter implementation, so add none to this three-card main list. A future study would filter only supplied published combinations; define Weekly precisely and require a known consistency value. Never renumber ranks or make the first visible paid card free. A later hide/show implementation must preserve DOM identity for the incumbent one-time hydrator.
06 · Protected access stays separate
The existing MDXAuth/controller and protected endpoint remain the owners. Confluence now emits tier_payload.v2: the frozen old v1 reader rejects it, and the current reader rejects prior v1 responses. Matching v2 still requires the full source receipt, expected IDs, counts, unique tickers and existing authorization/lifecycle checks before any replacement. The full artifact hash already binds the recipe; add no second recipe identity. Version rejection uses the existing access check; a source-generation mismatch uses Reload latest page. This fence blocks later incompatible hydration, not names already painted by an old page. Locked-card copy now says names require an eligible plan, matching the existing lower explanation. Following the unchanged trial link does not itself grant or hydrate names.
07 · Actions, method & motion
Qualified-zero Open Mastermind and the existing trial CTAs follow cta_url; the links themselves neither register an alert nor establish name access. Unavailable-source Reload page / 重新加载页面 uses location.reload(), retaining URL/query/hash; it neither starts a producer nor guarantees newer data. Keep native global and card method disclosures. Card Tab order is rank, history, ordered D/W badges, method summary, then company links. Focus stays on the same node and an open method remains open across resizing. Preserve visible focus and 44px-or-larger primary targets. Disclosure is immediate; any optional chevron/opacity motion stays ≤120ms and absent under reduced motion. No build-time loading shimmer.
08 · Focused implementation proof
Current copy source: 92 existing page tests pass. Four template literals and four saved-page text nodes have exact inverse checks; CSS, structure, scripts, values, hrefs and protected data remain unchanged. EN 390px / ZH 320px native visual inspections show readable eligible-plan copy and 44px CTAs, with zero page errors or overflow. These are inspections, not a new functional browser suite. Chinese 320px still isolates the icon through flex wrapping; that is the next layout fix. The prior 20-case layout proof at 27d50dc0, comparison/auth proof at 22fa830d and compatibility proof at f51b60de retain their own source identities.
09 · Canvas map & source pin
R2: eight variants and 24 cards now read identity → criteria → comparisons. Existing layer IDs, text and styles remain exact; 24 criteria groups are moved/reordered. Two first ZH desktop rank badges use alignment frames with zero-size anchors to avoid stretch (four new nodes). Desktop anatomy retains inline criteria, not pixel-identical production rows. R3 public states and full R4 subtree 2I3-0 remain byte-exact. Source: Draft PR10893 @d752f398; five source/text files and two new PNGs read back exactly. R2 anatomy already has neutral locked/public-evidence descriptions, so this copy increment changes no customer frames. Incumbent PR10705 @dce11e42 retains its admission/calendar boundary; production and wider programme acceptance stay separate.

01 · REPRODUCED SOURCE GAP
An ordinal ID is not a recipe identity.
The miner assigns L000n by selected-list position. The current hydrator joins only on combo_id, ignores built and announces success for empty, unmatched or partial arrays. A different snapshot can reuse the same ID and attach its names to the wrong public recipe. A malformed positive-count list can even become “no matches.”
02 · ONE EXISTING BUILDER
Bind both projections before rendering.
In scripts/build_confluence_screener.py, compute one artifact_sha256 from canonical raw JSON and a recipe_key from resolved signal ID, timeframe, kind, direction and applicable event windows. Reuse these in build_context and build_premium_payload. Preserve combo_id, rank, is_free and active_count. Public metadata contains no protected names. Full artifact built remains distinct from page-render time and the date-only display.
03 · ONE EXISTING HYDRATOR
Validate everything before replacing anything.
Require schema, fingerprint, full built, the exact expected protected-row set and each recipe_key to match. Require unique valid tickers and counts equal to the public card and payload list. Prepare all replacements first; mark hydrated only after complete application. Missing, extra, duplicate or malformed rows retain the public cards and existing protected-unavailable recovery. Zero expected protected rows need no paid-success announcement.
04 · COMPATIBILITY IS PART OF THE FIX
Reject unbound versions during rollout.
A new schema for this protected asset must be rejected by cached tier_payload.v1 code; the new consumer must also reject legacy unbound responses. Additive fields alone cannot fix cached old clients. Keep the existing endpoint, MDXAuth, inFlight and refresh path. Keep the missing-source empty overwrite; do not turn that empty file into successful hydration.
05 · CONTROL CONTRACT
Open the app; disclose the method locally.
All R2 app links say Open Mastermind / 打开 Mastermind and follow the existing cta_url. They do not start a trial, build a combination or grant access. Main controls are 48px; card links are at least 44px. The whole method row is a native details/summary target, with focus and expanded state; no fetch. Use the existing ≤120ms disclosure treatment and instant reduced-motion state.
06 · ACCEPTANCE
Mixed generations must fail before UI changes.
Test matching control, different generation, equal timestamp with changed content, wrong recipe, missing/extra/duplicate row, invalid/duplicate ticker, count disagreement, no protected rows and both old/new schema directions. Test a valid recovery through the current controller. Preserve rank, free status and usable public evidence throughout.

Layout specimens only. Labels and unavailable values remain illustrative; this is not live signal evidence.
